After many years of alcohol and drug abuse, I was persuaded by my family to get admitted in a rehab, I agreed. I was taken to Trucare by my father. I stayed in the rehab for about 02 months. The first few days were tough, but then I got used to the routine. They have multiple sessions and activities during the day that keep the you occupied and provide a structure to the day. The counsellors (Mr. Ashish, Guruji and others) are all very knowledgeable and empathetic. They provide a great support system and help you tackle your problems from the root up.

Its been 02 years since I have left the rehab and being sober has never been easier. The thought of using drugs or alcohol does'nt even cross my mind. Its like I was never an addict. I am truely thankful to my family and the team at Trucare for helping me get my life back on track.

If you are someone who is struggling with addiction, this is truely the right place to be in. Don't delay it, Don't think about it, Don't try to do it on your own. Get admitted now!!

Hope this review helps.
God Bless.

I admitted my elder brother to Jagriti Rehabilitation Centre, Taloja Branch, hoping he would receive proper care and support. Unfortunately, on 6th June, we received the shocking news that he had passed away at the age of just 30.
